name: Quake II

scale.why: player hull 56 u tall (mins z -24, maxs z 32, pmove.c#L994/#L1009), scaled to 1.8 m: 0.03214 m/u

ground_accel.note: Quake accelerate factor, same formula as Quark's

air_accel.note: pm_airaccelerate is 0, so the air uses PM_Accelerate with 1 and the full wish speed (no 30 u cap). Same formula as Quark's (accel x min(wish, cap)); Quark multiplies air_accel by 10, so 1 -> 0.1. (x0.0455 is outside the editor's 0.1..5 range: applying it clamps.)

air_cap.note: the wish speed the air push aims at

overstrafe.note: no overstrafe softening: the whole push against your momentum applies

ladder_side.source: https://github.com/id-Software/Quake-2/blob/master/qcommon/pmove.c#L460-470 (horizontal wish clamped to +-25 on a ladder)
ladder_side.note: per axis, in Quake 2's world axes (+-25 u/s each)

grapple.note: no grapple in the base game (CTF has one)

timeTo90.source: derived from this file's speed, ground_accel, friction, stop_speed
timeTo90.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 0.072 s

stopDistance.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopDistance.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 1.21 m

stopTime.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopTime.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 0.364 s

extras: air movement is weak (accel 1): little strafe-jumping compared with Quake 1
notes: Quake II's player movement is shared client/server code (qcommon/pmove.c).
